difficulty_reason: Prove the Hilb scheme is separated when X -> S is separated: use the universal object Z on H and its two pullbacks Z_1 = Z x H, Z_2 = H x Z on H x H; by the universal property of the representing functor, the diagonal Delta : H -> H x H parametrizes exactly those T with Z_{1,T} = Z_{2,T}, i.e. where both projections Z_T -> Z_{1,T}, Z_T -> Z_{2,T} are isomorphisms; by the very general flat-lemma-Weil-restriction-closed-subschemes Delta is a closed immersion; the author points to lemma-hilb-d-of-closed for an alternative easier special-case proof.
